title: Manager Kim
altTitles: Manager Kim: My Daughter Is Missing
description: Kim is a single father and an ordinary manager who works at a large company. Despite his unremarkable appearance and quiet personality, he is actually a former elite agent with extraordinary combat skills. When his daughter Minji suddenly goes missing, Kim's peaceful life comes to an end. Determined to find her at any cost, he returns to the violent world he left behind and confronts powerful organizations and dangerous enemies while uncovering the truth behind her disappearance.
author: Jeong Jong-taek / Toy (Park Tae-jun)
